officialSources.observation: Geomatics Department says it manages cadastral survey data and that OneMap is authoritative national map/land-registry source.
Hulhumalé Development Corporation Lots Public layer is Polygon and exposes LOT_NO, PARCEL_NO, AREA_SQM and ADMIN_NO; extent is around 73.5E, 4.2N and thus is Hulhumalé, not Malé island.
President’s Office says Male City Council is responsible for municipal services in Malé City, Hulhumalé and Villimalé.

ArcGIS FeatureServer layer metadata names this polygon layer “Parcels Public” and declares OBJECTID. Root service lists five polygon layers: Buildings Public (0), Lots Public (1), Parcels Public (2), Zones Public (3), and Phases Public (4). FeatureServer query returns non-null polygons; corresponding MapServer query returned null geometry in probes.

Public ArcGIS service directory lists a separate `Parcels_public_view` FeatureServer and MapServer. The FeatureServer contains a single `Parcel_Public_View` Polygon layer with OBJECTID and a Hulhumalé-area extent.

Public HDC portal web-map item data was inspected without reading attribute records. Two public web maps reference `DBO_Property_Public/FeatureServer/1` (Lots Public); the verified Parcel_Public_View layer is a separate public FeatureServer item.

registryBasis: National Geomatics Department sources establish cadastral survey and land-registry functions, and the public HDC lot service covers Hulhumalé within Malé City; the Dhivehi/English follow-up found no Malé-island layer. Geometry is verified only for the documented bounded sample, not comprehensive Malé-island coverage.

sourceCandidate.scope: Hulhumalé public parcels; official Male City Council sources include Hulhumalé within Malé City. Bounded geometry verified only in this extent.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: HDC public parcel layer; service extent around Hulhumalé, not Malé island. Official city-government evidence places Hulhumalé within Malé City.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Two Polygon features returned from Hulhumalé bounded query.

remainingUncertainty: Hulhumalé public polygons are associated with Malé City, but coverage is partial and excludes Malé island; runtime adapter checks passed via object-ID paging. Independent projected topology found a material near-duplicate overlap affecting nearly all of one feature, so quality remains held for review. No official current/inactive lifecycle filter is documented; STATUS is a nullable development status.

runtimeQualification.nativeIdentity: OBJECTID integer; OID identity only, no official cadastral code assumed
runtimeQualification.coverage: Hulhumalé only; partial Malé City coverage, not Malé island or complete municipal coverage
runtimeQualification.lifecycleStatusReason: No official active/inactive parcel lifecycle field or definitionExpression is documented. A targeted exact OID adapter read of the material-overlap pair found one Completed status and one null status; excluding null would be unsupported and would not resolve provider lifecycle truth.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Hulhumalé sample contains a 2,445.58 m² near-duplicate overlap covering nearly all of the smaller parcel. Nullable development STATUS is not a documented parcel-lifecycle rule.
